text:
Yes — Monzo is a real UK bank, not merely an app or a prepaid-card service. It is Monzo Bank Limited, authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and regulated by the PRA and Financial Conduct Authority (FCA); its Financial Services Register number is 730427.
monzo

What that means for you

You can receive your salary, set up Direct Debits and standing orders, make bank transfers, and use a sort code and account number.
monzo

Eligible deposits are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) up to £120,000 per person, subject to the usual eligibility rules.
monzo

It provides current accounts, savings products, business banking, and other banking services—not just a spending card.
apps.apple

Why it feels like “just an app”

Monzo is an app-first bank: it has no traditional high-street branches, so signing up, viewing balances, freezing a card, and contacting support are mainly done in the app. But the account itself is a regulated UK bank account, and you also get a physical debit card for shops, online purchases, and cash machines.
techadvisor

One caveat

The FSCS limit is £120,000, not the more commonly cited £85,000 figure, because it reflects the current UK scheme limit. If you keep large balances, check the FSCS eligibility rules and consider spreading deposits across institutions if appropriate.
